newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France allots cargo space to Air India.
newsitem.headline: Air France allots cargo space to Air India.

text.p: Air France said it will allocate three pallets of cargo space to Air India on each of its seven weekly Boeing 747-200F Paris-India services, effective from the 1997-98 winter season.
The allocation agreement forms part of an alliance between the two airlines announced earlier on Monday encompassing passenger and freight traffic, an Air France official told Reuters,
Air France operates 747 freighter services from Paris to Delhi, Bombay, Bangalore and Madras.

Air India will increase cargo capacity significantly on its Paris CDG-Delhi route from next month with Boeing 747-300 combis replacing 747 passenger aircraft, an Air India cargo official told Reuters.
